supplements: MR002_PrerequisiteProduction_Authorization_v1.0.json (2026-08-10). This record does NOT expand that authorization; it sequences the work already authorized there and adds one standing rule.

occasion.trigger: WP-E reached code completion 2026-08-11 (P10 producer + run-time FAIL-STOP gate, 44 tests), but the P10 runtime instance cannot be captured: the qualified launch host i-0f3ceafdd4294c572 no longer exists (InvalidInstanceID.NotFound, us-east-1).
occasion.rejected_option_1: Capture P10 on the developer laptop. REJECTED — it would bind an Intel/AVX-512 Windows runtime and then FAIL-STOP against any Linux run. The control would be working correctly on an operationally useless artifact.
occasion.rejected_option_2: Provision a replacement host now, solely to satisfy P10, before the custodian-side controls exist. REJECTED — it inverts the dependency order and produces a host that is not the intended execution environment.

directions.subject: WP-E
directions.direction: FROZEN AT CODE COMPLETE. Treat the P10 producer and the run-time FAIL-STOP gate as complete pending runtime capture. No further WP-E implementation work.
prohibitions: Do NOT add an escape hatch around the WP-B Requirement-7 resolver.
The two-leg design (13 in-image + 4 host bindings) and the 21-module rehash of the observation against module_digests_in_image are the correct boundary and are not to be relaxed.

directions.subject: WP-C and WP-D
directions.direction: PROCEED NEXT. Produce P6, P7, P8, P9 (WP-C) and P11 (WP-D) under the named operational-custodian / infrastructure roles.
directions.rationale: These prerequisites are independent of the eventual CPU and runtime identity and should be established before the execution environment is created.

directions.subject: Custody Requirement 7
directions.direction: STATUS HELD at IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_C_R7_VERIFICATION. Do NOT mark Requirement 7 fully satisfied.
directions.detail: The live ECR success-path demonstration of 2026-08-11 (bound index sha256:60b15568… pulled, bytes rehashed byte-exact, manifest_count 2, satisfies_requirement_7 true) is valuable evidence but is not C-R7. C-R7 requires a closed WP-F run proving the resolver is the SOLE path used by P10 and the run environment, and demonstrating fail-closed on digest miss, mismatch, and registry unavailability. C-R7 remains properly deferred to WP-F.

directions.subject: Phase 3C run host
directions.direction: After P6–P9 and P11 are complete, provision the actual Phase 3C run host. It is to be treated as the INTENDED EXECUTION ENVIRONMENT, not a temporary P10 machine.
qualification_required_before_p10_captur: evaluator-image resolution through the WP-B Requirement-7 resolver
any further host requirements already bound by the Phase 3A package

directions.subject: P10 capture
directions.direction: Capture P10 ONLY on that qualified host, PROSPECTIVELY, inside the bound evaluator image resolved through the WP-B resolver. Then seal the resulting NumericRuntimeIdentityManifest and make it the runtime identity against which Phase 3C must FAIL-STOP on drift.

directions.subject: WP-F
directions.direction: NOT AUTHORIZED. WP-F may be authorized only after P6–P11 are ALL satisfied. It then verifies C1–C10 plus C-R7, including P10 reproducibility.
directions.explicit_prohibition: The disappearance of the old run host is NOT a justification for skipping directly to grant readiness.

standing_rule.rule: Host replacement before validation INVALIDATES P10 and requires a fresh P10 capture and a re-run of grant-readiness verification.
standing_rule.failure_mode_prevented: A NumericRuntimeIdentityManifest generated on Host A while execution silently moves to Host B.
standing_rule.scope: In force from this record until the Phase 3C validation execution is complete.
consequence_if_triggered: The existing P10 instance is void, not merely stale.
P10 must be re-captured prospectively on the replacement host, which must first be qualified per D-S4.
WP-F must be re-run; a prior PASS does not carry over.

execution_order_as_directed: 1. WP-C — P6, P7, P8, P9 (operational custodian)
3. Provision AND qualify the real Phase 3C execution host (D-S4)
4. WP-E — capture the P10 instance on that qualified host (D-S5); seal it
5. Authorize and build WP-F; closed run over C1–C10 + C-R7 + P10 reproducibility
6. D3 resubmission with a FRESH adjudicated CAS anchor, then P12
standing_prohibitions_reaffirmed: Runtime evidence must be produced PROSPECTIVELY. Specification templates, retrospective attestations, inferred state, and placeholder completion do not satisfy a runtime-evidence prerequisite.
Any prerequisite that cannot be completed truthfully without validation access MUST remain unsatisfied.
§2.1 bounded scope: no new strategy research, architecture expansion, refactoring, product integration, or additional governance layers before the validation verdict.
